sharedTray.lead: Scans where you chose “Not sure / Shared tray” are kept separately here.
sharedTray.bannerTitle: Why are these scans kept separately?
sharedTray.bannerBody: Multi-cat homes often share one tray, so CatCheck can't tell which cat just used it. Results here aren't added to any cat's history and aren't compared with any cat's usual levels.
sharedTray.assignNote: Remember which cat just used the tray? You can reassign it within the allowed time after scanning; after that, the result stays here.
sharedTray.emptyDescription: When you choose “Not sure / Shared tray” while scanning, the result will appear here.
